sections.theory:
Long Jump

In the long jump the following stages are included.

Approach (Approach)

Jumping (Take off)

Flight (Flight)

Landing and recovery (Landing and recovery)

Approach

In the long jump the determination of the approach depends on the ability of the athlete. Some players jump using speed; they are called speed jumpers, and some players jump using strength; they are called power jumpers.

In the approach the following three qualities should be present.

Optimal speed: that speed over which there is control.

Rhythm (Rhythmic)

Consistency (Consistent)

Biomechanical principles in the Approach

For running, the player applies full force with his legs on the surface of the ground, as a reaction to which he moves forward. According to the third law of motion, the more force applied, the more will be the reaction in the opposite direction. Therefore the player should gain speed by applying force.
